title: When the Archive Falls
author: Beatrix Voss
blurb: Paloma Winterbourne, a memory-smuggler running contraband past orbital customs, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
